assumptions.choice: Aggregated daily bars into weekly bars manually by tracking ISO calendar week boundaries.
assumptions.reason: The execution environment provides a single daily data feed, whereas the specification mandates indicators (50-week SMA, 20-week Volume SMA) and triggers (weekly close) on the weekly timeframe.

assumptions.choice: Evaluated volume filter as weekly volume >= 70% of the 20-week volume SMA for long entry.
assumptions.reason: The specification defines the volume filter under Additional Rules as prohibiting entries if weekly closing volume is 30% or more below the 20-week average volume.

assumptions.choice: Risk per trade set to 1.0% of portfolio value, with risk per share equal to entry price minus the key support stop-loss ($8.78).
assumptions.reason: The specification mandates position sizing such that trade risk does not exceed 1-2% of total trading capital.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit ($13.92) and second support stop-loss ($8.23) checked on daily price action; primary stop-loss ($8.78) and 50-week SMA trend exit evaluated on weekly close.
assumptions.reason: The specification distinguishes between price 'reaching' $13.92 or 'falling below' $8.23 versus explicit 'break and weekly close below' $8.78.
